fn: Team Schedule, edit mode: new Auto-fill rules panel (Geologist and Core Checkers). Leave people out of auto-fill completely or for a date range, with an optional reason (vacation), and leave the end date empty for until further notice. Choose which shifts each group may work, a most-days-in-a-row limit with same-shift blocks (for example 5 mornings then a rest day), a full rest day when going from 3rd shift to 1st or 2nd, and filler loggers who cover a slot for one day while its usual person rests. Rules are remembered for the next months. The suggestion bar shows how many filler days were used.
